# costfluent_dashboard_widget (Resource)

Manages one widget of a Costfluent dashboard: a saved cost report drawn as a chart, a table or a KPI, or a text widget whose words are rendered as markdown emphasis without HTML. Needs a token with `viewCostReports`, `updateDashboard` and `viewDashboards` on the workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "costfluent_workspace" "production" {
  name     = "Production"
  currency = "USD"
}

resource "costfluent_dashboard" "engineering" {
  workspace_id = costfluent_workspace.production.id
  title        = "Engineering Costs"
}

resource "costfluent_cost_report" "by_service" {
  workspace_id = costfluent_workspace.production.id
  title        = "Spend by service"
}

# A saved cost report drawn as a chart (the default), a table or a KPI
resource "costfluent_dashboard_widget" "spend" {
  workspace_id   = costfluent_workspace.production.id
  dashboard_id   = costfluent_dashboard.engineering.id
  cost_report_id = costfluent_cost_report.by_service.id
  title          = "Spend by service"
  display        = "table"
  position       = { x = 0, y = 0, w = 8, h = 4 }
}

# Words beside the numbers, rendered as markdown emphasis without HTML
resource "costfluent_dashboard_widget" "notes" {
  workspace_id = costfluent_workspace.production.id
  dashboard_id = costfluent_dashboard.engineering.id
  type         = "text"
  title        = "Notes"
  content      = "Compute is *up* after the migration; storage should fall next month."
  position     = { x = 8, y = 0, w = 4, h = 4 }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dashboard_id` (String) ID of the dashboard the widget is on. Changing it recreates the widget.
- `position` (Attributes) Where the widget sits on the dashboard grid. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--position))
- `title` (String) Widget title.

### Optional

- `content` (String) A Text widget's words, at most 10,000 characters, rendered as markdown emphasis without HTML; required for one, not allowed on a CostReport widget.
- `cost_report_id` (String) ID of the cost report a CostReport widget renders; required for one, not allowed on a Text widget. Changing it recreates the widget, because a different report is a new widget.
- `display` (String) How a CostReport widget draws its report: chart (the default at creation), table or kpi. Not allowed on a Text widget. Omitting it later keeps the display the widget has.
- `type` (String) costReport (the default) for a saved cost report, text for words. Changing it recreates the widget.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID of the dashboard. When omitted, the provider's default workspace at creation is recorded and kept, so a later change to the provider's default does not move it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Widget ID.

<a id="nestedatt--position"></a>
### Nested Schema for `position`

Required:

- `h` (Number) Height in grid rows.
- `w` (Number) Width in grid columns.
- `x` (Number) Column the widget starts at.
- `y` (Number) Row the widget starts at.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A widget is addressed through its dashboard.

# The configuration sets workspace_id: "<workspace ID>:<dashboard ID>:<widget ID>". Import with
# that workspace, because changing a configured workspace_id recreates the widget.
terraform import costfluent_dashboard_widget.spend wsp_0000000000000000000001:dsh_0000000000000000000001:wdg_0000000000000000000001

# The configuration leaves workspace_id out: "<dashboard ID>:<widget ID>" imports from the
# provider's workspace, which state then keeps.
terraform import costfluent_dashboard_widget.spend dsh_0000000000000000000001:wdg_0000000000000000000001
```
